newsitem.title: USA: U.S. WEEKLY RICE CASH MARKET SUMMARY -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. WEEKLY RICE CASH MARKET SUMMARY -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady during the week ended August 9, according to USDA's weekly rice cash market summary.

Long grain milled rice prices were quoted mostly at $20.00 per hundredweight (cwt) with discounts of up to $1.00. Medium grain was quoted mostly at $18.00; second heads were $0.50 to $1.00 lower; brewers were steady.
Rice by-products were uneven. Bran was steady to $5.00 lower, millfeed was steady to $3.00 higher.
In California, rice prices were steady with medium grain selling mostly at $18.00, second heads were $0.50 cents lower, bran was $10.00 to $12.00 higher.
California rice ship loadings: For the week ending August 9, 1997: no rice ships were loaded.

Inspections of California rice for export: For the week ending August 9, 1997, there were no rice inspections. The yearly total since October 1, 1996 is 10,359,531 cwt compared to 6,992,387 cwt a year ago.
